descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
## QPS limit
The single-user QPS limit for this operation is 10 calls per second. If the limit is exceeded, API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. Call this operation at a reasonable frequency.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudfw describe-page-documents --source-ip 223.167.221.XXX --lang zh --source-code yundun --page-name overview --tab-name internet --region cn-hangzhou
